name: Two-Color Two-Pair
description: Form two pairs — each pair same color + same number — using two different colors and two different numbers.

name: Three Different Colors
description: Have at least three different colors in your hand.

name: Two of the Same Color
description: Have at least two dice of the same color.

name: Two of the Same Number
description: Roll at least two dice showing the same number.

name: Sum 11+ No Ones
description: Roll a sum of 11 or more without any 1s.

name: Two Adjacent Numbers
description: Have at least two consecutive numbers (e.g. 3-4).

name: Two Pairs of Colors
description: Have at least two colors each appearing two or more times.

name: Two Same Numbers on the Same Color
description: Have two dice of the same color showing the same number.

name: Odd-Even-Even
description: Have at least 1 odd value and at least 2 even values among your dice.

name: Three Straight Numbers
description: Have at least three consecutive numbers (e.g. 3-4-5).

name: Even-Odd-Odd-Odd
description: Have at least 1 even value and at least 3 odd values among your dice.

name: Sum 12+ No Twos
description: Roll a sum of 12 or more without any 2s.

name: Sum 15+ With a Five
description: Roll a sum of 15 or more with at least one 5.

name: Three of the Same Color
description: Have at least three dice of the same color.

name: Four Different Colors
description: Have at least four different colors in your hand.

name: Only Red and Yellow
description: All six dice must be Red or Yellow.

name: Only Blue and Orange
description: All six dice must be Blue or Orange.

name: Only Purple and Green
description: All six dice must be Purple or Green.

name: Three of the Same Number
description: Roll at least three dice showing the same number.

name: Four Straight Numbers
description: Have at least four consecutive numbers (e.g. 2-3-4-5).

name: Three Straight on Three Different Colors
description: Have three dice showing consecutive numbers, each a different color.

name: Sum 17+ No Threes or Fours
description: Roll a sum of 17 or more without any 3s or 4s.

name: Sum 14+ No Fours or Sixes
description: Roll a sum of 14 or more without any 4s or 6s.

name: Five Different Colors
description: Have at least five different colors in your hand.

name: Four of the Same Color
description: Have at least four dice of the same color.

name: Full House of Numbers
description: Roll three of one number and two of another (XXX + YY).

name: Four of the Same Number
description: Roll at least four dice showing the same number.

name: Five Straight Numbers
description: Have at least five consecutive numbers (e.g. 1-2-3-4-5).

name: Three Straight With Two Doubles
description: Have three consecutive numbers where both end values form a pair (e.g. 2-2-3-4-4).

name: Four Straight No Sixes
description: Have four consecutive numbers without any 6s.

name: Sum 20+ No Fours
description: Roll a sum of 20 or more without any 4s.

name: Sum 18+ on Four Different Colors
description: Roll a sum of 18 or more across at least four different colors.

name: Only Two Colors on Five or More Dice
description: Have five or more dice made up of only two colors.

name: Six Different Colors
description: Have all six different colors in your hand.

name: Five of the Same Number
description: Roll at least five dice showing the same number.

name: Four of a Kind Plus a Pair
description: Roll four of one number and two of another.

name: Three Same Numbers on Three Same Colors
description: Have three dice of the same color all showing the same number.

name: Six Straight Numbers
description: Roll all six consecutive numbers: 1-2-3-4-5-6.

name: Sum 23+ No Fives
description: Roll a sum of 23 or more without any 5s.

name: Exact Sum 25
description: Roll a sum of exactly 25.

name: Two Different Three-of-a-Kinds on Different Colors
description: Have two groups of three — each group the same color and same number — using different colors.

name: Six Straight on Six Colors
description: Roll 1-2-3-4-5-6 across all six different colors.

name: Six of the Same Number
description: Roll all six dice showing the same number.

name: Sum 36+
description: Roll a sum of 36 or more (all sixes).

name: Sum 29+ No Sixes
description: Roll a sum of 29 or more without any 6s.

name: Six of the Same Color
description: Draw all six dice of the same color.
